## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run e2e` passes, or the change cannot affect the browser
- [ ] New logic without DOM access has a `*.test.ts` next to it
- [ ] Colours only through the tokens at the top of `src/style.css`; works on a phone and with the keyboard
- [ ] README or CONTRIBUTING updated if what users or contributors see changed
- [ ] Nothing here helps use an engine in a game against a human (see the fair-play section of CONTRIBUTING.md)
